title: Wolfenstein Began as a Stealth Game Before id Made It a Shooter
hook: Wolfenstein began in 1981 as a stealth game where you dragged guards out of sight, until id Software cut the sneaking for speed in 1992. With Wolfenstein 3 confirmed this week, which classic series should come back next?
script: Did you know Wolfenstein started out as a stealth game, not a shooter? The name goes back to Castle Wolfenstein, a nineteen eighty one Apple Two game by Silas Warner at Muse Software. You sneaked through a castle, wore disguises, and slipped past the guards. Many call it one of the first stealth games, years before Metal Gear. Muse went out of business in the mid eighties, leaving the name unclaimed. A tiny Texas studio called id Software had grown up playing it. Early in nineteen ninety two, id's John Romero pitched the team a 3D remake of that castle game. The early builds copied the stealth. You could drag guards out of sight and break into lockers for food and ammo. Guards who found a body came hunting for you. Then the team played it. Romero said the game came to a dead stop every time you did those things. The fun was in running and gunning, so they ripped the stealth out. Wolfenstein 3D went out as free shareware on May fifth, nineteen ninety two, and the first person shooter was never the same. This week, Xbox and MachineGames confirmed that Wolfenstein 3 is in production. It will be the first new mainline Wolfenstein since twenty seventeen. So which classic series deserves a comeback next?
